comparison.objective: Transfer a newborn manikin from a bassinet to a changing pad while supporting its head.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual whole-body support across a passive neck joint during lifting and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Neck never exceeds 20° and body never exceeds 30° tilt; manikin ends aligned, released, and stable for 1 s.
comparison.reason: This tests coordinated support of an articulated load, not precision tooling, controlled hammer impulse, material separation, or small-part recovery.
